The mathematics behind machine learning, with Python: linear algebra, derivatives and gradient descent, then statistics. Each section has a **lesson**; many also have **exercises** and their **solutions**.

Each section has a zip with the lessons, the exercises and the data, so you can run everything on your computer (Python 3 with Jupyter, or [Anaconda](https://www.anaconda.com/download)). Solutions stay on this site.


## Linear algebra

1. **NumPy arrays**: Create, index, reshape and combine arrays: the building block of linear algebra in Python. [Lesson](01-numpy-arrays/lessons/numpy-arrays.ipynb) · [Quiz](01-numpy-arrays/quiz/quiz.qmd)
2. **Linear systems in 2 variables**: Write a system as a matrix, compute its determinant, solve it by elimination. [Lesson](02-linear-systems-2/lessons/linear-systems-2.ipynb) · [Quiz](02-linear-systems-2/quiz/quiz.qmd)
3. **Linear systems in 3 variables**: The same tools in three dimensions, with row reduction. [Lesson](03-linear-systems-3/lessons/linear-systems-3.ipynb) · [Quiz](03-linear-systems-3/quiz/quiz.qmd)
4. **Matrix multiplication**: The definition, how to compute it with NumPy, and broadcasting. [Lesson](04-matrix-multiplication/lessons/matrix-multiplication.ipynb) · [Quiz](04-matrix-multiplication/quiz/quiz.qmd)
5. **Vector operations**: Scalar multiplication, sum of vectors, norm and dot product, and why vectorised code is faster. [Lesson](05-vector-operations/lessons/vector-operations.ipynb) · [Quiz](05-vector-operations/quiz/quiz.qmd)
6. **Linear transformations**: What makes a transformation linear, and how matrices move the plane. [Lesson](06-linear-transformations/lessons/linear-transformations.ipynb) · [Quiz](06-linear-transformations/quiz/quiz.qmd)
7. **Principal component analysis (PCA)**: Reduce the number of columns while keeping most of the information. [Lessons](07-pca/lessons/pca-introduction.ipynb) · [Exercises](07-pca/exercises/house-prices.ipynb) · [Solutions](07-pca/solutions/house-prices.ipynb)

## Calculus

8. **Derivatives in Python**: Symbolic, numerical and automatic differentiation, and their limits. [Lesson](08-derivatives/lessons/derivatives.ipynb) · [Quiz](08-derivatives/quiz/quiz.qmd)
9. **Gradient descent in one variable**: Find the minimum of a function step by step, and see what the learning rate changes. [Lesson](09-gradient-descent-1d/lessons/gradient-descent-1d.ipynb) · [Quiz](09-gradient-descent-1d/quiz/quiz.qmd)
10. **Gradient descent in two variables**: The same method on surfaces, with local and global minima. [Lesson](10-gradient-descent-2d/lessons/gradient-descent-2d.ipynb) · [Quiz](10-gradient-descent-2d/quiz/quiz.qmd)

## Statistics

11. **Statistics basics**: Data types, centre and spread of a distribution, the normal distribution. [Lesson](11-statistics-basics/lessons/statistics-basics.ipynb) · [Quiz](11-statistics-basics/quiz/quiz.qmd)
12. **Confidence intervals**: Estimate a population mean from a sample, and visualise the uncertainty. [Lessons](12-confidence-intervals/lessons/confidence-intervals.ipynb) · [Exercises](12-confidence-intervals/exercises/estimates-and-sampling.ipynb) · [Solutions](12-confidence-intervals/solutions/estimates-and-sampling.ipynb)
13. **Hypothesis testing**: H₀ and H₁, z-scores, p-values, and one- or two-tailed tests. [Lesson](13-hypothesis-testing/lessons/hypothesis-testing.ipynb) · [Exercises](13-hypothesis-testing/exercises/loan-control.ipynb) · [Solutions](13-hypothesis-testing/solutions/loan-control.ipynb)
14. **A/B testing**: Design an A/B test and decide with a statistical test. [Lesson](14-ab-testing/lessons/ab-testing.ipynb) · [Exercises](14-ab-testing/exercises/airbnb.ipynb) · [Solutions](14-ab-testing/solutions/airbnb.ipynb)
